title: Evaluation of the Diagnostic and Prognostic Value of Immunohistochemical Markers in Precancerous Lesions of the Cervix
official: Evaluation Of The Diagnostic And Prognostic Value Of Immunohistochemical Markers In Precancerous Lesions Of The Cervix
summary: The study aims to evaluate the expression of certain proteins and their diagnostic and prognostic value in precancerous lesions of the cervix.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with a diagnosis of CIN/SIL undergoing cervical biopsy/concussion whose tissue sample is archived at the Operative Unit of Pathological Anatomy and Histology
* Obtaining written informed consent for the use of biological samples
* Patients aged 18 years and over

Exclusion Criteria: none
